Footer.description: SISARPRAS is a school facilities and infrastructure information system that helps simplify the process of reporting damage, monitoring report status, and managing facilities and infrastructure data in a more organized and accessible way.
Footer.tagline: SISARPRAS - School Facilities & Infrastructure Information System

Home.title: SISARPRAS
Home.description: An integrated school facilities service for reporting damaged facilities and monitoring the handling process.
Home.heroDescription: Report damaged school facilities and infrastructure easily and monitor the handling process. Every report will be processed and you can monitor it until completion.
Home.informationDescription: Latest updates regarding services, maintenance, and school facilities and infrastructure announcements.
Home.selfReporting: Reports can be submitted anytime through the web.
Home.developmentDescription: The SISARPRAS website is still under development. Some features may not yet be available or may still be undergoing improvements.
Home.guideDescription: Complete your report so the Sarpras team can understand the damage and follow it up promptly.
Home.fillReporterDescription: Enter the reporter's name, WhatsApp number, and email that can be contacted.
Home.determineLocationDescription: Select the location or room, then enter the name of the damaged item.
Home.explainDamageDescription: Clearly describe the type and condition of the damage. Include a photo if available.
Home.determineUrgency: Determine Urgency and Submit the Report
Home.determineUrgencyDescription: Choose the urgency level according to the damage condition, then submit the report.
Home.processDescription: Your report will be processed from submission until completion.
Home.reportDescription: Fill out the form with data and information about the damaged item.
Home.verifiedDescription: The Sarpras team will review the report and ensure that the information provided is accurate.
Home.processedDescription: Verified reports will be followed up by the team for repair.
Home.completedDescription: Once the repair is completed, the report status will be updated and can be viewed by the reporter.
